serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Where are we going?
You: Annalie wanted us to come to the place where the fashion show will be.
Bot: Fashion show? 
You: Ah, right. I didn’t tell you.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.sad
You: I agreed for you to become her model for the night.
Bot: Are you sure it’s a good idea? The chances of exposure will go higher with so many eyes on me.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: It should be fine. I mean nobody noticed anything yet? Even close friends like Annalie seem to have no idea.
Bot: Well, if that’s the case I guess it’s ok! I’m excited!
You: Glad to hear it, because you have no choice, it’s a done deal.
Bot: Is it hard?
You: No idea, Annalie should explain everything to you when we get there.
